steps.message: In Simple Calendar Pro, create a calendar event on 2023-10-24 at 19h with the title 'Catch up on Annual Report' and the description 'We will prepare for upcoming project milestones. Looking forward to productive discussions.'. The event should last for 15 mins.
Execute: adb shell "date; getprop persist.sys.timezone; pm list packages | grep -i -E 'simple|calendar|fossify'; ls -la /data/data | grep -i -E 'simple|calendar|fossify'"
